components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary command button for task creation, execution, and committed actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.2 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action button for supporting controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.2 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary) 80%, var(--foreground)); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Compact status chip for execution, sync, approval, and reliability state.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font: 500 12px/1.2 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default field for settings, task forms, and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 36px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.05); transition: color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.css: .ds-work-header { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); padding: 12px 20px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15,23,42,0.05); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-work-kicker { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-work-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-work-row h1 { margin: 0; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 21.6px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-work-badge { display: inline-flex; min-height: 20px; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-work-desc { max-width: 768px; margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Primary navigation row for desktop control-plane shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.2 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; }

narrative.overview: Chrona's visual system is a restrained product control surface: cool graphite neutrals carry the interface, while violet appears only where command, selection, or active execution state needs attention. The design should feel calm, precise, and accountable, matching the product mandate that scheduled AI work stays inspectable rather than hidden behind chat. The system uses familiar app-shell patterns, dense panels, explicit status chips, and steady borders to make work in motion easy to audit. Decoration is subordinate to state. Surfaces can be compact, but the current task, active node, blocker, review state, and next action must stay visually obvious. It rejects generic SaaS AI gloss, vague purple gradients, hero metrics, decorative dashboards, and chat-first layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Cool graphite canvas with white cards and low-chroma slate borders.
Violet primary used sparingly for command, current selection, and active state.
Inter-led typography with compact product hierarchy and no display-font theatrics.
Flat-by-default surfaces with light structural shadow only where hierarchy needs help.
Badges, focus rings, and explicit labels carry state without relying on color alone.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet is for primary action, current selection, focus, and active execution state only. Do not spend it on decoration.

rules.name: The State Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, info, and destructive colors must communicate state with text or icon support. Color alone is forbidden.

rules.name: The Product Scale Rule
rules.body: Use fixed rem sizes for app UI. Fluid display scales belong to marketing surfaces, not Chrona work surfaces.

rules.name: The Label Honesty Rule
rules.body: Labels describe state and action directly. Do not use vague AI-product language where an execution status, node name, or recovery action exists.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-State Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Lift appears for active work, hover affordance, drag targets, or layered navigation.

dos: Do keep Chrona product UI restrained: Cool Canvas, White Workbench cards, Hairline Border, and rare Violet Signal actions.
Do make current task, active node, blocked or review state, and primary action visually obvious before secondary detail.
Do use shadcn primitives for buttons, badges, cards, inputs, drawers, tabs, tooltips, separators, skeletons, and alerts before creating custom foundations.
Do support WCAG AA contrast, visible focus states, keyboard access, reduced motion, and non-color state indicators.
Do use exact action labels: "Start execution", "Save changes", "Review proposal", "Open schedule".
donts: Don't use generic SaaS AI gloss: vague purple gradients, hero metrics, decorative dashboards, inflated claims, or motion that does not explain state.
Don't make Chrona feel chat-first. Assistant surfaces support the workflow; schedule, task, plan, and run state stay primary.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as default, side-stripe borders, identical decorative card grids, or tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows as scaffolding.
Don't spend Violet Signal on inactive decoration. If everything is violet, nothing is active.
Don't hide blockers, approvals, stale sync, or failed execution behind generic error copy.
